--csharpDesignTimePath <csharpDesignTimePath> Full path to the C# design time target path (optional).
--extensionLogDirectory <extensionLogDirectory> The directory where we should write log files to
--pipe <pipe> The name of the pipe the server will connect to.
--stdio Use stdio for communication with the client.
--autoLoadProjects <autoLoadProjects> The server should automatically discover and load projects based on the workspace folders. Optionally accepts an integer specifying the maximum number of projects to auto-load; if no value is supplied, defaults to a server-recommended limit.
--sourceGeneratorExecutionPreference <Automatic|Balanced> Controls when source generators are executed. [default: Automatic]
--clientProcessId <clientProcessId> The process ID of the client process. The server will terminate when the client process exits.
--daemon Run as a multi-client daemon that listens for connections on the pipe named by --pipe. This is an internal option used by the roslyn-language-server thin client; end users and editors should not pass it directly.
--daemonKeepAlive <daemonKeepAlive> Seconds the daemon stays alive after its last client disconnects before exiting. Zero exits immediately and -1 keeps the daemon alive indefinitely. Defaults to the env var 'ROSLYN_LANGUAGE_SERVER_DAEMON_KEEPALIVE' if set, otherwise 900 seconds. [default: 900]
-?, -h, --help Show help and usage information
--version Show version information
